review.tagline: Image, video and lip-sync studio UI that calls MuAPI, with optional local engines
review.summary: A JavaScript app, available as a web build and an Electron desktop app, that front-ends hosted image, video, audio and lip-sync models through the MuAPI service. The desktop app can also run local inference: a bundled stable-diffusion.cpp engine for SD 1.5, SDXL and Z-Image, or a user-installed Wan2GP for video models and Flux. Most generation depends on a MuAPI account, and the README promotes a paid white-label offering.
review.audience: Creators wanting one UI for hosted and local image and video generation
strengths: Desktop app can run sd.cpp locally with Metal, CUDA, Vulkan or ROCm, no API key
Wan2GP integration runs video models locally or on a remote GPU box via MCP
Multi-image input accepts up to 14 reference images on compatible edit models
Installers provided for macOS (arm64, x64), Windows and Linux (AppImage, .deb)
weaknesses: Cloud generation requires MuAPI; the 600+/200+ model claims run through that paid service
Local inference is desktop-only; the hosted web version always uses cloud APIs
Installers are unsigned, so macOS Gatekeeper and Windows SmartScreen need manual bypass
Z-Image needs about 16 GB RAM and is reported to hang 8 GB Macs
needs: Needs MuAPI account/API key, Wan2GP (optional, for local video), stable-diffusion.cpp (bundled), Node.js (for source builds)
Models: Flux, Nano Banana, Kling, Sora, Veo
